Robbery Accused Posing as 'Kali Sarkar' Arrested in Jhansi

Police in Jhansi have arrested an individual known as 'Kali Sarkar' who was living as a religious figure in a temple. The arrested man was identified as a robbery accused wanted by Hardoi police for several years. A joint operation by Jhansi and Hardoi police led to his apprehension. Reports indicate he was living under an assumed identity as a 'baba' and had a significant following on Instagram.
